captions.text: Ten hours a day. For twenty years.
And they tell you humans built this.
Five clues. When three stars rise over these pyramids tonight... you'll know who really built them.
On average, heavier than a car.
No cranes. No steel. And every two minutes...
For almost four thousand years, nothing on Earth stood taller.
But the heaviest stones... aren't out here.
